The CubeFS ObjectNode provides an S3-compatible object storage interface that allows applications using AWS S3 SDKs and tools to interact with CubeFS storage without modification. The ObjectNode listens on port 17410 by default and supports standard S3 operations including bucket creation and deletion, object CRUD, multipart uploads, access control lists (ACLs), and pre-signed URL generation. Authentication uses AWS Signature Version 4 with access keys and secret keys managed by the CubeFS Master API.
